title: Strive Buys 6,182 Bitcoin For $511 Million, Lines Up $1 Billion ATM To Buy More
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Strive Buys 6,182 Bitcoin For $511 Million, Lines Up $1 Billion ATM To Buy More Strive purchased 6,182 BTC for $511.4 million at an average of $82,732 per bitcoin, increasing its total holdings to 43,000 BTC. This post Strive Buys 6,182 Bitcoin For $511 Million, Lines Up $1 Billion ATM To Buy More first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
